title: FloorEvent
description: Emitted by the backend SignalR hub once per floor as the elevator arrives at or passes through that floor. Contract version: 1.0

floorNumber.description: Floor the elevator is at or passing through. 0 = ground floor (German convention).

direction.description: Direction of travel at the moment this event was emitted.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the backend processed this event. Source of truth for display; never use the client clock for displayed timestamps.
